exemplars.title: AI at your Fingertips: Wearable Ring as a Low-Friction Interface for Agentic AI
exemplars.why: The paper explicitly centers a screenless, “fire-and-forget” handoff, directly supporting the pattern’s complete nonvisual delegation and subsequent disengagement; however, the excerpt does not establish the full initiation–specification–termination sequence or prove that monitoring and mid-flight correction are impossible.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It is the only supplied candidate, so there is no runner-up against which to make a comparative selection.

notes: Only one candidate was provided, so a defensible final set of three cannot be produced without inventing records; this output retains the sole eligible exemplar. I lowered its consensus score from 3.82 to 3.4 because the evidence establishes the subject matter unusually well but not the complete structural signature: the gesture, nonvisual specification channel, terminating signal, task complexity, absence of intermediate feedback, and impossibility of correction are all undocumented. Readers should therefore distrust any claim that the quoted excerpt alone demonstrates the entire interaction loop.
